title: Kalon Mac and 44 Bird came together to release their recent single "Mia"
htmlContent:
American fast-rising artist Kalon Mac comes together with 44Bird in their recent single "MIA." Fast making a name for themselves for their fresh yet polished sound, "MIA." They are both up-and-coming hip-hop artists that need to be on your radar.

Kalon Mac and 44 Bird bring their talent together to make a smash of a collaboration on the new song "MIA." "Mia" is that supreme level of music that keeps us fans of music. They truly showcase the art of music and the soul it can have to make something beyond words.
